description: Coefficient-selection runs (seed 42, TRAIN/VALIDATION only, before any test evaluation). For every candidate value: the validation AFA and validation accuracy matrix on 3DO and WiMANS (row s: validation accuracies on the domains seen after update s) and their mean; 'selected' applies the rule of configs/protocol.json (first maximum on ties), 'locked' is the value in configs/locks.json. 'same_input' holds the per-input re-selection of the same-input study (m9216 reuses the main selection).
